newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker levels firm on crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker levels firm on crude gains.

text.p: Continued crude strength supported Singapore bunker prices at high levels on Thursday and traders expected bullish sentiment to continue.
Recent slower off-port-limit bunkering as well as month-end berth congestion also boosted prices, they said.
Offers were overall higher, with bunker 380-cst supplies at about $104 per tonne and the 180-cst grade was at around $107.
MDO and gas oil were at around $175 and $183 per tonne respectively.
